standard_prerequisites.name: The formal functions theorem identifies the completion of the stalk of the pushforward of the structure sheaf with the inverse limit of the sections of the infinitesimal neighbourhoods of the fibre
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the compatible system of idempotents whose limit is the required element of the stalk.

standard_prerequisites.name: Sections and idempotents can be descended along a proper limit of schemes of finite presentation over a Noetherian base
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the general case to the Noetherian case.

core_obligations: Write the fibre as the disjoint union of two nonempty open and closed pieces corresponding to the idempotent, so that the idempotent is one on one piece and zero on the other (proof lines 8341-8344).

In the Noetherian case, apply the formal functions theorem to identify the completion of the stalk of the pushforward with the inverse limit of the sections of the infinitesimal neighbourhoods (proof lines 8345-8349).

Since each infinitesimal neighbourhood has the same underlying space as the fibre, obtain a compatible system of idempotents on those neighbourhoods, whose limit is a nontrivial idempotent of the completed stalk (proof lines 8350-8360).

Use that the idempotent lifts along the completion map for a Noetherian ring, so that it comes from an element of the stalk, and verify that its image is the given idempotent, which proves the Noetherian case (proof lines 8361-8375).

In the general case, write the situation as a proper limit of schemes of finite presentation over affine Noetherian bases and use the descent statements for sections and for irreducible components to reduce to the Noetherian case already handled (proof lines 8376-8397).
proof_roadmap: Translate the idempotent into a decomposition of the fibre and treat the Noetherian case with formal functions (proof lines 8341-8375).
Reduce the general case to the Noetherian one by a limit argument (proof lines 8376-8397).
difficulty_reason: 57 行、两段：Noetherian 情形用形式函数定理把推前的完备化写成各阶无穷小邻域截面之逆极限，在每一阶由「邻域与纤维同底空间」得到自洽的幂等元系统，取极限后说明它来自 stalk（完备化上幂等元可提升）；一般情形用「proper 有限展示的极限」把问题化到 Noetherian 情形。承重步骤（形式函数、自洽系统、极限归约）都在 span 内；6 处引用全跨章，作导航桩。
